jobs.description:
Do you want to head up quality and food safety at Harboe’s production site in Skælskør? Do you possess a strong professional background within QA/QC, and are you motivated by driving a proactive quality culture in close collaboration with production? Then you might be the one we are looking for.

About us

Harboes Bryggeri produces and sells beer, soft drinks, and malt- and fruit-based ingredients and beverages. Production takes place at our breweries in Skælskør and at the fully owned Darguner Brauerei in Germany. Both sites produce and package beverages in glass, cans, and PET, while Dargun also handles draught beer. Malt-based ingredients and concentrates are produced in Skælskør.

Quality and food safety are fundamental to everything we do. The Quality Department plays a key role in ensuring compliance, maintaining high standards, and safeguarding product quality from raw material to finished goods.

The position and Key responsibilities

As Quality Manager, you will have overall responsibility for leading Harboe’s Quality Department and ensuring the effective operation, maintenance, and continuous alignment of our quality management system.

You will become a part of the Group Quality Team and report directly to the Plant Director in Skælskør, with a dotted line reference to the Director, R&D, ESG and Quality.

Your primary focus will be to lead and develop our QA and QC teams while ensuring that our quality and food safety standards are consistently implemented and maintained across the organisation. Through visible leadership and close collaboration with production and other key stakeholders, you will ensure that quality remains an integral part of daily operations.

Building on our existing quality management system, you will drive systematic and continuous quality improvements. The role covers in-house products, ingredients, raw materials, packaging materials, and quality-related activities throughout production. You will ensure compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements while ensuring that the quality function supports customer expectations and operational needs.

Main focus areas include:

• Leading and developing the Quality Department, including QA and QC teams, ensuring clear priorities, strong collaboration, and a high level of engagement.

• Ensuring effective implementation and maintenance of the quality management system (IPW), including compliance with standards such as IFS and FSSC 22000.

• Planning, conducting, and following up on internal and external audits, including training of the internal audit team in Skælskør.

• Maintaining close cooperation with production, including handling of deviations, root cause analysis, and follow-up on corrective actions.

• Ensuring professional handling of customer complaints, including documentation, investigation, and timely follow-up.

• Ensuring compliance with food legislation, regulatory requirements, and quality standards, including communication and documentation.

• Supporting supplier quality requirements, including hygiene standards and HACCP-based controls through training and monitoring.

"In Skælskør, we believe that world-class quality is built right on the production floor through strong relationships, transparency, and a shared mindset. As our new Quality Manager, you will not just be managing systems and compliance from an office—you will be a visible and motivating partner directly in our operations. If you are ready to take true ownership, inspire your team, and bridge the gap between regulatory standards and daily production practices, we can’t wait to welcome you on board."

– Plant Director, Mogens Auchenberg

About you

You are a strong and present leader with solid experience from QA/QC in a food or similar regulated industry (e.g. ingredients or pharma). You have hands-on experience with HACCP, GMP, and certifications such as IFS and FSSC 22000, and you are familiar with food legislation and regulatory requirements across markets.

You work in a structured and analytical way and are known for being proactive, resilient, and communicative. You are able to motivate and engage others and have a strong focus on collaboration and operational execution.

You ideally hold a relevant degree within Food Science, Food Technology, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Engineering, or a similar field.

Interested?

If you would like to learn more about the position, please feel free to contact Plant Director, Mogens Auchenberg at mau@harboe.com.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, CV, and any relevant supporting documents.

The first round of interviews will take place on 7 December 2026, followed by a second round on 14 December 2026. We kindly ask applicants to keep these dates available.

Harboes Bryggeri views diversity as a strength and encourages all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply.

Build software at scale. Influence how we build it. Help modernize a product area at the heart of construction projects.

Dalux is growing, and we are looking for an experienced software developer to join our Box Collab team.

You will build software in our File Management product (Box) that enables communication and collaboration across construction stakeholders—for example, file comments, sharing, versioning, and review. This domain is widely used and deeply integrated across the Dalux product suite, so reliability, performance, and strong technical design are essential. In Box Collab, we foster an engaging, enjoyable work environment where people take ownership and accountability for outcomes. You’ll join a young, skilled team with strong opportunities to influence both product evolution and architectural direction.

**Your role

**As an Experienced Software Developer, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will join a full-stack development team working closely with a Product Manager and Product Designer. We expect experienced developers to contribute beyond their individual tasks: helping make good technical decisions, improving the codebase and architecture, sharing knowledge, and raising the engineering standard around them.

Within Box Collab, there is a particular focus on strengthening and evolving the technical foundation of the product while continuing to deliver new functionality.

Your work can include:

• Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end

• Designing and implementing scalable, maintainable solutions

• Contributing to architectural decisions and the technical direction of Box Collab.

• Improving the structure of an established codebase and reducing technical debt

• Helping evolve boundaries and modularity within the application

• Sparring with and mentoring other developers

• Working closely with Product Management and Design to understand problems and find the right solutions

• Bringing new ideas, technologies, and development practices into the team when they create real value

We expect experienced developers to have opinions, challenge existing solutions, and be comfortable having their own ideas challenged in return.

**AI-assisted software development

**We are significantly increasing our focus on AI-assisted development across Dalux.

We are actively exploring how AI can improve the software development lifecycle – from understanding requirements and exploring technical approaches to coding, testing, review, debugging, refactoring, and automation.

The Box Collab team is already experimenting with how these tools can improve its day-to-day development work.

As an experienced developer, we want you to take an active role in that development: experimenting with new workflows, critically evaluating their value, sharing what works, and helping establish good engineering practices around AI-assisted development.

Practical experience using AI as part of your development workflow is an advantage. More importantly, you should be curious about how these tools are changing software engineering and willing to continue evolving your own way of working.

**Technologies we work with

**Box Collab is a full-stack product area primarily built with:

• C# / .NET

• Angular / TypeScript

• MSSQL

• Elasticsearch

Our wider platform runs on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS.

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and improve complex systems matter more.

**What would make you a particularly strong match?

**We are looking for an experienced software developer with strong technical fundamentals and the ability to influence the software around you.

For this particular team, we would especially value:

• Str ong professional experience with C# and .NET

• Strong DB management experience, including indexing strategies and query performance optimization.

• Experience improving or modernizing established software systems

• An understanding of Domain-Driven Design, modular architecture, or similar approaches to structuring complex applications

• Experience mentoring or providing technical sparring to other developers

• Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools and workflows

You do not need to match every point.

Technical judgment, curiosity, and the ability to make an established product better are more important than having worked with exactly the same technologies or architectural patterns before.

**Product development at Dalux

**Our product teams bring developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers together.

Developers are expected to understand the problem being solved and contribute to finding the solution – not simply implement specifications handed to them.

As an experienced developer, you will have an important voice in balancing user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

Our products are relied upon by professionals worldwide, making performance, stability, maintainability, and quality important parts of everyday engineering.

**What You Can Expect From Dalux

**Dalux is a software company at heart.

As an experienced developer, you can expect:

• Significant ownership of the software you build

• Real influence on technical solutions and engineering practices

• Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussion and constructive challenge

• Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design

• Short paths from technical ideas to decisions and implementation

• Opportunities to improve an established product and architecture

• A healthy work-life balance, with a strong focus on a sustainable work week and no overwork culture.

• Clear opportunities for professional and career growth.

• An environment actively investing in AI-assisted software development

• High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems

• A social workplace with monthly events and employee-driven clubs

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. Working together in person is an important part of how we collaborate, share knowledge, and make decisions quickly.

**About Dalux

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, Dalux develops user-friendly software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers the opportunity to influence both the products and the technology behind them.

**Interested?

**If you are looking for a role where you can remain hands-on while gaining greater technical influence and helping evolve an established product and architecture, we would like to hear from you.

We recruit continuously as Dalux grows.

**Application deadline:

**Ongoing

SENIOR BACKEND DEVELOPER

🚀 We're looking for an ambitious, self-driven Senior Backend Developer to join our engineering team. You'll work primarily with TypeScript and AWS serverless technologies, with occasional work in our React/Next.js frontend. A growing part of our platform is integrating with enterprise customers and external systems, so you'll design and own APIs and integrations that need to hold up under real-world use.

This is a high-impact role with end-to-end ownership, from requirements to a production-ready solution, and a chance to contribute meaningfully to the green transition.

🛠️ What You'll Be Doing

• Taking features from design through implementation and into production

• Building and operating event-driven, distributed systems — async processing, retries, failure handling, idempotency

• Designing APIs and integrations for enterprise and external systems — stable contracts, versioning, auth, error handling, backwards compatibility

• Working in and improving our existing codebase — refactoring, automated testing, managing technical debt

🧠 Your Experience

You think carefully about system boundaries and integration contracts, understanding that APIs used by customers and external systems need to evolve safely and behave predictably when either side fails. You understand rollback, backwards compatibility, failure modes and safe deployment for systems handling production data.

You communicate trade-offs clearly and take responsibility for the quality of what you ship.

You're comfortable using AI-assisted development tools as part of your day-to-day work, and curious about how they can improve how software is designed, built, tested and maintained - not just for code generation, but for understanding unfamiliar code, planning changes, testing, reviewing, debugging and documentation. At the same time, you apply strong engineering judgement: you treat AI-generated output as a draft to review and validate, and you remain responsible for the correctness and security of what you ship.

🌟 Nice to Have

• Enterprise integrations - SSO/federated identity, webhooks, customer-facing APIs

• AWS CDK or similar IaC tooling

• DynamoDB single-table or composite-key modelling

• IoT, connected devices, telemetry or high-volume event processing

• Multi-tenant SaaS platforms

• Energy tech, EV charging, batteries, solar or energy management

• Data platforms, analytics or data lakes

• ISO 27001 or NIS2 experience

• Next.js

You don't need experience with every technology in our stack. We value strong fundamentals and the ability to learn unfamiliar domains fast.

🌆 What Is It Like to Work at FLEXECHARGE?

• Our office sits in Frederiksberg - bright, comfortable, and a genuinely nice place to spend your workday

• You're covered with pension contributions

• Lunch is on-site, delicious, and genuinely healthy and nutritious

• We like each other's company outside of work too, so think Friday bars, plus company team events and team buildings on a team level

🤝 Our Interview Process

Here's roughly what happens once we've had a look at your application:

• A first conversation, about 30 minutes, you'll talk with our recruiter, get a feel for the role, ask whatever's on your mind, and we'll both get a sense of whether this is worth pursuing further

Hiring carefully matters to us - we want to get to know you properly, and we want you to get a real feel for us too. If there's anything we can do to make the process work better for you, tell us.

We'd love to hear from you. Find a link to apply here 👉 https://thehub.io/jobs/6ab5030dfd5518f38b6960b2?utm_source=client&utm_medium=dashboard&utm_campaign=startupshared

📍 Location & Practical Details

This is an on-site role based in Copenhagen.

Only candidates currently located in Copenhagen, or those who clearly state in their application that they plan to relocate, will be considered.

Please note:

• We do not offer visa sponsorship for this role

🔐 Data Privacy (GDPR)

We are seeking engineers with experience in one or more of the following areas:

• Offshore substations

• Onshore substations

• Offshore export cables

• Onshore export cables

You will take ownership of assigned engineering work packages, from FEED and tendering through delivery and handover.

In these roles, you will apply your experience to shape and challenge supplier solutions from the owner’s perspective, coordinate technical expertise and resolve delivery issues.

Within the project, you will report to the respective Package Manager and work autonomously within your assigned scope, drawing on technical specialists and collaborating with Interface Managers, Procurement and other project functions.

Deliver assigned engineering work packages in accordance with contractual requirements and project and contract milestones. Plan and coordinate activities, and monitor and report on safety, quality, progress and cost within your scope.

• 
Apply a systems engineering mindset so decisions within your scope support the performance, integration, optimisation and delivery of the overall transmission system—not individual contracts in isolation.

• 
Keep the design basis, requirements, interface decisions and contractual scope aligned, coordinating the impact of changes on affected packages.

• 
Work with Interface Managers and project teams to define and resolve technical and contractual interfaces, including scope boundaries, engineering inputs and delivery dependencies.

•

Share lessons learned and contribute to improving requirements, engineering practices and project delivery.
